abstract: Four hundred and forty-four patients with the histological diagnosis of pure seminoma were treated at The Princess Margaret Hospital between 1958 and 1976. Using the Walter Reed Hospital staging classification, 338 patients (76.1%) were Stage I, 86 (19.4%) were Stage II, and 20 (4.7%) were Stage III. The 5 year actuarial survival rate (5 yr Sa) for all stages was 87%, and for Stages I, II and III: 94%, 74% and 32% respectively. In Stage II the 5-year Sa was significantly worse when palpable abdominal disease was present (62%, vs 87% when it was absent, p less than .02). Prophylactic mediastinal irradiation was not used for patients with Stage II disease. None of 40 Stage II patients without palpable abdominal disease recurred in the non-irradiated mediastinum. Ten of 46 Stage II patients with palpable abdominal disease recurred in the mediastinum; 7 of the 10 were cured with mediastinal irradiation at the time of relapse. Prophylactic mediastinal irradiation appears unnecessary in Stage II patients. The Stage III category includes a subgroup of patients who were curable with radiation therapy:L 5/6 with supradiaphragmatic nodal disease without palpable abdominal or visceral disease were cured. Exploration of new treatment methods appears indicated for the salvage of patients recurring in sites other than the mediastinum or supraclavicular fossa and for patients presenting with visceral disease.
abstract_ja: 1958年から1976年の間にプリンセス・マーガレット病院で、純粋セミノーマの組織学的診断を受けた444例を治療した。ウォルター・リード病院の病期分類を用いると、338例(76.1%)が病期I、86例(19.4%)が病期II、20例(4.7%)が病期IIIであった。全病期の5年実測生存率(5年Sa)は87%であり、病期I、II、IIIではそれぞれ94%、74%、32%であった。病期IIにおいて、腹部の触知可能な病変がある場合の5年Saは、ない場合(87%)に比べ有意に不良であった(62%、p<0.02)。病期II患者には予防的縦隔照射は行わなかった。腹部触知病変のない病期II患者40例のうち、非照射の縦隔に再発した例はなかった。腹部触知病変のある病期II患者46例のうち10例が縦隔に再発し、そのうち7例は再発時の縦隔照射によって治癒した。予防的縦隔照射は病期II患者には不要と考えられる。病期IIIのカテゴリーには放射線療法によって治癒可能な患者のサブグループが含まれ、横隔膜上リンパ節病変のみで腹部や内臓の触知病変がない5/6例は治癒した。縦隔や鎖骨上窩以外の部位に再発した患者や、内臓病変を呈する患者の救済には、新たな治療法の検討が必要と思われる。
